description: When user changes 2FA setting on web app - activation or deactivation. This event follows the flow of that process. Flow (start, cancel, error, complete): starts when user checks or unchecks two-factor authentication button on web app. If error, includes the error property. Complete when message '2FA is off' or '2FA is on' is displayed.  The flow_type tells which flows the user is in - activation or deactivation flow.Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/eBon4v44dd9utwtooZjFDI/%5BAS%5D--2FA-Settings---WebApp?node-id=1%3A2.
